nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build context exclusion list that prevents development artifacts, virtual environments, and local config files from being copied into the production image.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build using python:3.13-slim that installs system dependencies, sets up the UV package manager, installs Python dependencies from a lockfile for layer caching, copies application code, and launches via start.sh on port 80.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses UV package manager with a two-stage dependency install pattern (lockfile-only first, then full project install) to maximize Docker layer cache hits.
